name: Nurude Sasara
source:
A popular comedian.

He originally performed as part of the manzai duo “Dotsuitare Honpo” with Rosho.

He was hailed as a genius from the moment of his debut, and after the duo disbanded, he continued to thrive as a solo comedian.

His comedic style relies heavily on puns and wordplay, and he handles a wide range of roles from TV show host to reporter.

His goal is to make the whole world burst out laughing with their comedy.
